content: Create a Next.js middleware that adds a custom header "X-Request-Id" with a unique value to all responses. The middleware should also log the request pathname to the console.

I have created the Next.js `middleware.ts` file in the root directory. 

It intercepts all
incoming requests, logs the request pathname to the console, generates a unique `X-Request-Id` using the Web
Crypto API (`crypto.randomUUID()`), and attaches it to the response headers.
